suite: 52 synthetic German HA-like scenarios, two production sampler seeds, Strata Q2/Strata Q3/27B vLLM
live_schemas: 2026-10-04 read-only tools/list from configured official HA MCP, 46 tools
simulator: Fresh synthetic home per case. Live HA source verified: exact names/aliases/entity IDs, area/domain/device_class/floor filtering; HA-shaped Live Context result, brightness 0..255 and volume 0..1; successful mutations update state.
baseline_timing_caveat: Final Q3 and 27B runs start after preparation/download completes.
baseline_original_grading: Final runs use corrected fixture/selector. Summary accepts already-satisfied desired states and recoverable read/schema errors; unrequested mutation attempts fail the task.
manual_review: Same Codex assistant authored and reviewed semantic rubrics, not blinded or independent
excluded_runs: exploratory/ uses a simplified selector without device_class filtering and incomplete entity IDs; intermediate-v2 was interrupted during simulator correction. Neither contributes to final quality counts. pre-equivalent-light-correction/ rejected equivalent light brightness calls and is excluded from quality and short latency; all three quality and short-latency arms were rerun.

hardware.gpu2: RTX 5060 Ti is not assigned to the test containers. Its separate workload memory occupancy changed from about 14903 to 527 MiB during the test.

cold_start_note: q3-cold-startup.json is the first model load; later quality/latency runs reuse the same loaded model. Excluded exploratory quality fixtures do not affect model load measurement.
performance_protocol: 512 German article tokens, greedy, three shared cold prompts at 4K/64K/128K, one sample each. One short and one 64K unscored warmup. Cached tokens must be <=32. Matched six HA latency cases with seeds 20261006 and 20261007, both profiles warm after quality suite.
q3_quant: GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS; existing Unsloth UD-Q3_K_XL unsupported
light_action_equivalence: Brightness zero fulfills pure turn-off, positive brightness fulfills pure turn-on, only for the requested entity. Actual brightness still updates the simulated state.
capacity_phase_note: Q3 and 27B cold capacity samples were completed before the final light-action simulator correction; those independent article-generation probes use unchanged benchmark_flash_prefill.py, same shared corpus, same profiles and 512 output tokens. Q2 capacity probes ran after the correction. No quality records from excluded simulator versions contribute to final counts.
